title: Chris Crawford Dragon Speech "I Had a Dream"
summary: Chris Crawford's 'Dragon Speech' from the first Game Developers Conference, in which he reflects on his dream for game design as an art form. This is a cleaned-up version of the old recording.
why: HN people mention it as a notable historical talk from the early game industry, though some see it as showing his eccentricity.

quote.text: Perhaps of interest: the dragon speech, delivered by chris crawford at the first video game developers conference in 1992
